notice.title: Educational research tool
lines: This software is an educational research and backtesting tool. It is not investment advice, not a trading signal service, and it has no broker connection or live execution.

All results are simulated on historical data using the recorded strategy and execution assumptions. Simulated results are not evidence of a profitable edge and historical performance does not guarantee future results.
The author is not a licensed or registered financial adviser. Trading leveraged foreign exchange involves a high risk of loss; nothing here should be used to place real trades.
